sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: web_enable
toolsAdded.description: Enable configured pi-web-access tools for web research and content retrieval. Does not search or fetch. Enabled tools are available on the next model request; disabled capabilities remain unavailable.

args.description: Tool arguments as a JSON object, or as a JSON string encoding one

connect.description: Server name to connect (lazy connect + metadata refresh)

instructions.description: Server name to show that server's usage instructions

searchMode.description: Search backend (default: lexical; semantic is available when a System One key is configured)

regex.description: Treat search as regex (default: substring match)

includeSchemas.description: Include parameter schemas in search results (default: true)

server.description: Server name: filters searches, disambiguates calls and describe operations, and optionally names an install

toolsAdded.name: mcp__atlassian
toolsAdded.description: Namespace-proxy for MCP server "atlassian". Forwards `{tool, args}` through the adapter's executeCall, so it inherits the same auth / lifecycle / output-guard rules as the `mcp` proxy.

tool.description: Underlying MCP tool name to call on this server.

args.description: Arguments for the underlying tool. When mcp is available, use mcp({ search: '...' }) to inspect schemas; for unique names use mcp({ describe: 'tool_name' }) with the exact tool name returned by search.

target.description: Memory scope. Use failure for failures, corrections, insights, and tool quirks.

old_text.description: Substring identifying the entry to replace.

target.description: Memory scope. Use failure for failures, corrections, insights, and tool quirks.

old_text.description: Substring identifying the entry to remove.

skill_id.description: Stable skill id for view/patch/update/delete. e.g., 'global:debug-typescript-errors' or 'project:my-repo:release-app'. Legacy alias 'edit' also accepts this field.

description.description: Discovery-only summary of what the skill does and when to use it. Include the trigger signals a user would actually type (error strings, symptoms, phrasings) — Pi indexes skills by this field alone. Required for create; optional for update/edit; max 1024 chars.

scope.description: Required for create. Use 'global' for portable procedures and 'project' for repo-specific workflows.

section.description: Required for patch. Section header to patch. e.g., 'Procedure', 'Pitfalls', 'Verification', 'When to Use'.

content.description: Raw markdown body for create/update/edit, or Markdown section body for patch. Prefer structured fields over free-form content when possible. For patch, JSON arrays are auto-coerced for list sections; JSON objects are rejected.

when_to_use.description: Structured create/update/edit field, or structured patch body when section is 'When to Use'. Renders into the skill body only — it does not participate in Pi's skill index, so discoverable trigger signals belong in 'description'.

procedure_steps.description: Structured create/update/edit field, or structured patch body when section is 'Procedure'. Ordered concrete steps.

pitfalls.description: Structured create/update/edit field, or structured patch body when section is 'Pitfalls'.

verification_steps.description: Structured create/update/edit field, or structured patch body when section is 'Verification'.

query.description: Search query. Use natural language or specific terms.

limit.description: Maximum results to return (default: 10, min: 1, max: 20).

snippetChars.description: Maximum characters per result snippet (default: 1200, max: 4000).

query.description: Search query. Use natural language or specific terms.

project.description: Filter by project name. Pass null for global memories only.

target.description: Filter by target type: memory, user, failure, or project-attributed memories.

toolsAdded.name: subagents_enable
toolsAdded.description: Enable pi-subagents delegation and management tools without launching work. Call when delegation is authorized by the current request or applicable user/project instructions, or when managing existing runs. Direct execution is the default; complexity alone never authorizes delegation. Full tools are available on the next model request.

query.description: What to look up in the library's documentation. This is used to rank library results by relevance to what the user is trying to accomplish. The query is sent to the Context7 API for processing. Do not include any sensitive or confidential information such as API keys, passwords, credentials, personal data, or proprietary code in your query.

libraryName.description: Library name to search for and retrieve a Context7-compatible library ID. Use the official library name with proper punctuation — e.g., 'Next.js' instead of 'nextjs', 'Customer.io' instead of 'customerio', 'Three.js' instead of 'threejs'.

libraryId.description: Exact Context7-compatible library ID (e.g., '/mongodb/docs', '/vercel/next.js', '/supabase/supabase', '/vercel/next.js/v16.2.9') retrieved from 'resolve-library-id' or directly from user query in the format '/org/project' or '/org/project/version'.
